targets.os: Raspberry Pi OS 64-bit (Debian 13 trixie), labwc/Wayland + Xwayland
targets.result: Full screen. Gate 4 (3 runs): fighting 35.6-36.6 avg / 24.5-27.6 min FPS, 0 s below 15, max 56 C; campaign map about 35; menus 55-60

stack.emulation: Box64 0.4.5 (commit a46caf3, -DRPI4ARM64=1), built from source into ~/stw/box64 by the setup
stack.wine: Kron4ek Wine 9.17 amd64-wow64 in ~/stw/wine-x64-9.17, with this project's winex11.so (built from the Wine 9.17 source)
stack.graphics: WineD3D -> OpenGL on V3D, d3d9lazy shim (GOG's own ddraw.dll proxy left in place); full screen through Xwayland emulated modes
stack.mesa: Mesa 26.2.6 + patches/mesa-v3d-busy-range.patch, built into ~/stw/mesa-patched by the setup
